verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for an SDK/platform product like Cloudflare Sandboxes, but the evidence pack contains no versioned API scheme, changelog, or documented deprecation policy for the Sandbox SDK. The only related item is a note that ReadableStream support in writeFile() replaces the "base64" encoding option; that is a single feature replacement, not a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe shows a machine-readable spec exists but says nothing about versioning or deprecation.
